description: Focused mitigated repeat of the gr_beta_bump_n4 distribution using the best Phase 5 layout/noise audit candidate. This remains distribution measurement only, with no Grover amplification or QAE.
rationale: The Phase 5 hardware run used optimization_level=2 and seed=12345, giving TVD 0.045590.
The exact-profile noisy audit predicted TVD 0.043878 for that executed candidate, close to the observed hardware result.
The best audited candidate, optimization_level=3 and seed=45678, keeps 16 two-qubit gates while reducing predicted TVD to 0.021744.
This focused repeat tests whether layout/seed choice can stabilize localized Grover-Rudolph distributions before any amplified QAE attempt.

selected_cases.label: beta-like localized bump, 16 midpoint cells
selected_cases.purpose: Focused repeat of the localized 16-cell distribution using the best audited opt/seed candidate.

stopping_rules: Do not attach Grover amplification to gr_beta_bump_n4 until this focused repeat is retrieved.
If repeated TVD remains near 0.045, classify localized n=4 profiles as direct-distribution-only for the current backend.
If repeated TVD moves near 0.02, proceed with observable-specific direct estimators before considering amplified QAE.
